articles.title: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
articles.snippet: The derivatives regulator is proposing a formal rule to include certain contracts traded on platforms like Kalshi's as swaps that require the agency's oversight.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Wealthy investors are buying crypto, but their advisers aren’t sold
articles.snippet: Wealthy investors are embracing crypto faster than their advisers, while OKX attracts new funding and Strategy shifts more capital toward preferred stock buybacks.

articles.title: NFL backs New Jersey authorities in SCOTUS petition over Kalshi
articles.snippet: According to the league, Kalshi and other prediction markets “threaten game integrity” because many event contracts are “highly susceptible to manipulation.”

articles.title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
articles.snippet: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the “swap” definition, while an interim rule excludes casino-style gambling—sharpening the agency’s claim to exclusive jurisdiction.

articles.title: Blockchain.com Seeks Approval for US Prediction Markets and Crypto Derivatives
articles.snippet: The crypto platform filed for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses, which would let it run its own regulated event-contract venue instead of relying on overseas partners.
